# choices.md — the build's choices where the design is unclear or leaves a case open (J156)

The design is a reference, not a contract. Where it is unclear, or the fix list leaves a case open, the seat that meets
the case picks, records the pick here and names the test that holds it; the tests judge. One row per choice; rows are
append-only (a reversal is a new row naming the row it replaces). A choice that changes the design's text is also routed
to the fix list, and the design is corrected later from it.

Columns: **id** · **date** · **seat** · **design section** · **the choice** · **the reason** · **the test that holds it**.

| id | date | seat | section | the choice | the reason | test that holds it |
